panel.field.sensor_hint: Without a sensor the line is never blocked (it always waters).
panel.field.override_hint: Automatic/schedule only: waters automatically even when wet/moist. A manual start ignores the blocking sensor anyway.
panel.field.manual_default_hint: Standard: minutes (e.g. 5). For seconds enter m:ss (e.g. 0:18 = 18 s, filling a watering can).
panel.field.skip_settle: Manual draw-off: skip the settling time
panel.field.skip_settle_hint: For hose/direct draw-off: a manual start skips the source's settling time (immediately free again). Cistern consumption is then approximate, mains water exact.
panel.field.output_hint: A controller output of type „Other" or „Pump" (e.g. a relay for a fountain or camera). Create it in the controller editor.
panel.field.show_on_dashboard_hint: Off = settings only, not on the dashboard.
panel.control.duration_hint: A schedule duration of empty/0 means „on until stopped manually" (continuous). For a planned off, set a regular duration (on at 20:00 for 600 min = off at 06:00).
panel.field.deadband_hint: 0 = off. The fill level shown holds until the reading differs from it by at least this much — against a jittery display at rest (e.g. 5 L). Takes effect immediately, no reflash needed.
panel.field.multiplier: Linear shortcut: multiplier (L per raw unit)
panel.field.multiplier_hint: Only in effect while NO support-point table (≥ 2 points) is set.
panel.field.label: Short code (e.g. A → A5)
panel.field.outputs_hint_generic: Channel = output id (A5). GPIO = physical ESP pin (free choice). The entity is derived automatically (see the hardware overview).
panel.field.outputs_hint_gc: Channel = output id (A5). The ESP pin is fixed by the GardenControl profile. The entity is derived automatically (see the hardware overview).
panel.field.inputs_hint_generic: Pin = ESP input (free choice); rain/soil moisture carry their blocking parameter. The entity is derived automatically (see the hardware overview).
panel.field.inputs_hint_gc: Pin = ESP input; rain/soil moisture carry their blocking parameter. The entity is derived automatically (see the hardware overview).
panel.cal.label: Calibration — support points (raw value → litres)
panel.cal.hint: The raw value is the uncomputed live reading of the level sensor ({entity}; with generated firmware the plain electrical measurement — ADC voltage or 4-20 mA current, not a pressure or a height). One point ties „the sensor reads X" to „the tank holds Y litres"; the table interpolates piecewise linearly and folds the sensor curve and the tank shape into one curve.
panel.cal.table_inactive: Only active from 2 complete points — otherwise the linear shortcut below applies.
panel.cal.empty: No support points. Type the table in or capture a reading.
panel.cal.range_below: The reading is below the lowest support point. The fill level therefore sticks at that point's litre value: runs log 0 L of consumption and the minimum fill level can no longer take effect. Add a support point below it.
panel.cal.range_above: The reading is above the highest support point. The fill level therefore sticks at that point's litre value: runs log 0 L of consumption and the minimum fill level can no longer take effect. Add a support point above it.
panel.warn.runtime: ⚠ Run time collides with the emergency shutdown. The valve „{valve}" cuts off after {emerg} min via its emergency shutdown. These durations leave less than 1 min of reserve (> {limit} min) and will be logged as „emergency shutdown": {list}. Set the duration below {limit} min or raise the output's emergency shutdown in the controller editor.
panel.general.title: General
panel.general.disabled_boxes_hint: Off: lines and sensors of a disabled controller are hidden and a „Controller disabled" row appears instead. On: they stay visible (greyed out).
panel.general.order_hint: Position of the water sources and the blocking sensors relative to the lines. Controls always stay at the bottom.
panel.general.platforms_hint: GardenControl and ESP32-WROOM are built in. You can name your own (generic) platforms — they behave like WROOM (free GPIO).
panel.general.gc_profile: fixed profile: 12 valves (24 VAC) · 2 relays (R1/R2, 230 V) · 2× 4-20 mA (IN1/IN2) · 4× ADC 0-12 V · 3× binary (rain/S0/switch)
panel.general.wroom_profile: generic: GPIO freely assignable per in-/output
panel.general.sync_hint:
Maps a controller's in- and outputs to the real ESPHome entities in HA (matched by the entity name, not the entity_id — an entity_id is never changed by this). Normally not necessary: the match runs automatically when a controller is saved, when the integration starts and after every change to a controller's ESPHome entities (self-healing after a flash that adds or renames entities). Triggering it manually makes sense when:
  • a controller has just been added to HA as an ESPHome device and the mapping in the hardware overview is still empty (—);
  • you have renamed an entity in HA and the resolution should not or does not follow immediately;
  • something looks unresolved (the dashboard/overview shows —) and you want an immediate x/y matched reply.

wiring.note.unsupported_platform: A wiring diagram is currently only available for ESP32-WROOM and GardenControl.
wiring.note.wroom_gnd: Connect each device's GND to any GND pad (marked).
wiring.note.wroom_control_line: Valves and pumps run via relays / 24 VAC — only the control line (GPIO) is shown here.
wiring.note.wroom_suggestion: The diagram is a wiring aid (a suggestion), not a picture of your actual board.
wiring.note.gc_silkscreen: Terminal plan following the real GardenControl board (silkscreen labels).
wiring.note.gc_valves: Valves V1–V12: switched wire to Vn, shared return to COM (bus bar).
wiring.note.gc_relays: Relays R1/R2 (interposing relays): coil to the relay output + COM (just like a valve); the two 24VAC terminals are the transformer feed-in, not a connection point for the coil. The volt-free contact side (e.g. a 230 V pump) is NOT shown — external, qualified electrician.
wiring.note.gc_4_20ma: 4-20 mA sensors on IN1/IN2: 2-wire — signal to INx, supply (+) to the VCC terminal next to it (24 V DC). No GND (the current loop closes internally).
wiring.note.gc_analog: Analog/DC sensors on ADC1–4 (0–12 V): sensor minus/GND to the GND terminal, supply from +5V/+12V/+24V.
wiring.note.gc_binary: BIN1–3 = binary (rain/S0/switch): volt-free contact between the VCC pad left of BIN1 (24 V DC query voltage, short-circuit proof) and BINx — the same for a Rain-Clik or a push button as for S0 meters (water/electricity).
wiring.fn.bin_query_supply: Query voltage for the binary inputs (24 V DC)
